header.title: DatePicker
header.description: Field to pick a date, a range or a date and time from a calendar. Supports locales, output formats, min and max limits, and quick month and year navigation.

playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Start date

base.title: Base
base.description: Single date selection with label, placeholder and helper text.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: `locale` takes a BCP 47 code and translates months, weekdays and the formatted value.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: `format` defines how the value is shown. Tokens: YYYY, YY, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, DD and D.

range.title: Range
range.description: `range` lets you pick a start and an end date. The value is { start, end }.

texts.label: Stay
texts.helperText: Pick a start date, then an end date.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.helperText: Use the X next to the clock to clear without opening the calendar.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: With range and `showTime` you can edit the start and end time separately.

texts.label: Event window
texts.helperText: Use Start / End to edit each time.

minuteStep.title: Minute step
minuteStep.description: `minuteStep` sets the interval between minutes in the picker.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: Time tokens: HH, H, hh, h, mm, m, A and a.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows an X to empty the field without opening the calendar.

texts.label: Invoice date
texts.helperText: Use the X next to the calendar icon to clear the value.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` blocks the field and the calendar.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: `isLoading` shows a spinner and `loadingText` while the value arrives.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.helperText: The field shows loadingText next to the spinner.

loadingThenValue.title: Loading then value
loadingThenValue.description: Starts in `isLoading`. After 2 seconds the date is set and the spinner stops.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` marks the field as invalid and forces the error border.

texts.label: Due date
texts.errorMessage: Select a due date to continue.

minMax.title: Min and max
minMax.description: `minDate` and `maxDate` disable dates outside the interval.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.helperText: Only dates from today through next month are enabled.

birthDate.title: Birth date
birthDate.description: For distant dates, click the month or year to jump quickly.

texts.label: Date of birth
texts.helperText: Click the month/year to jump to a distant year.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` changes the border tone. It is forced to error when the field is invalid.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip
withTooltip.description: `infoText` adds an info icon next to the label.

texts.label: Billing period
texts.infoText: The invoice is generated on this date.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the date with value and `onChange`.

controlledRange.title: Controlled range
controlledRange.description: In range mode, value and `onChange` work with { start, end }.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, DatePicker accepts native <button> attributes (ButtonHTMLAttributes) except onChange, value, defaultValue and size. They are applied to the button that opens the calendar; className also goes to the button and wrapperClassName to the root.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.trigger: The field is a <button> with aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the calendar.
a11y.dialog: The calendar uses role="dialog" with the visible month as aria-label; the days grid uses role="grid".
a11y.keyboard: Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the field.
a11y.label: helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.label: Field label.
rules.control: Wraps the field and the popover.
rules.trigger: Visible button that opens the calendar. Receives `className`.
rules.valuePlaceholder: Applied to the value while the placeholder is shown.
rules.icons: Container for the calendar and clock icons.
rules.nav: Row with previous and next month buttons.
rules.caption: Visible month and year. Opens the months or years view.
rules.period: Each month or year in the grid.
rules.clockItem: Each hour or minute in the picker.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.
rules.open: Applied while the calendar is open.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Own variable and gem-system tokens used by DatePicker. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-datepicker-range: Background of days inside the range. Defined on each .gem-datepicker__day.
items.--gem-color-accent: Border while the calendar is open.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Inner buttons, months and years radius.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <button> attributes except `onChange`, value, `defaultValue` and size.

items.value: Controlled value. Date in single mode, { start, end } in range mode.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: on the border (outline) or above the field (above).
items.placeholder: Text shown when nothing is selected.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.locale: BCP 47 locale for month names and the formatted value.
items.format: Output pattern. With `showTime` the default is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm.
items.minuteStep: Minute interval in the time picker.
items.weekStartsOn: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.
items.clearable: Shows an X to clear without opening the calendar.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to "Clear date".
items.isLoading: Shows a spinner and blocks the calendar.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.name: Native name for the hidden input (start date in range mode).
items.endName: Native name for the end-date hidden input (range mode).
items.className: Extra classes for the field button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Fires when the date or range changes.
items.onDateChange: Single mode: fires when the date is picked, updated or cleared.
items.onRangeChange: Range mode: fires when start or end changes.
items.onMonthChange: Fires when the visible month changes (0–11).
items.onYearChange: Fires when the visible year changes.
items.onTimeChange: Fires when the hour or minute changes.
items.onClear: Fires after the date is cleared with the button.
